learning_outcomes.text: Students possess fundamental general knowledge and fundamental specialized and methodological knowledge in the area of project management.
Students acquire knowledge in planning, monitoring, and controlling projects and in designing the necessary organizational structure and processes.
Students apply selected project management techniques.
Students apply this knowledge in various teams using a practical software or organizational project. This promotes cooperation, communication, and conflict resolution skills.

syllabus_topics: Recognizing the characteristics of projects compared to line tasks in a company, requirements for a project manager and their tasks

Project organization - presentation and discussion of different forms of organizing a project team, possible division of tasks and responsibilities between project manager and line managers, composition, tasks, and responsibilities of other committees in a project organization

Project planning and controlling - presentation of different types of project plans and their dependencies, procedure for project planning, presentation of risk management in projects, dimensions of project steering and control with associated tools, methods, and procedures
Project phases - introduction of selected project phases, learning tasks in these phases
Techniques - introduction of soft skills of a project manager (creativity techniques, moderation, presentation)
Acquisition of knowledge in using software for project planning and control through practical exercises
Kanban - practices, process, rules, best practices
Fields of application and combination of Classical and Agile Approaches
Partial execution of a practice-oriented software or organizational project in a team
teaching_methods: Exercises/Case studies in individual and group work
